input_needed: Confirmed kickoff date
why_needed: Every date in the mobilization plan is expressed relative to kickoff; without it no schedule in the kit resolves to a calendar

input_needed: Named engagement sponsor and day-to-day University point of contact
why_needed: The coordination forms have contact slots that cannot be filled by the kit; escalation path is undefined without them

input_needed: Authoritative list of AIS teams in scope and the services each one runs
why_needed: Determines how many evidence sets exist and which assessment areas apply to each; the kit currently exercises three fictional teams

input_needed: Written scope boundary: which systems and data are explicitly out of scope
why_needed: Prevents the assessment from collecting evidence it has no authorization to hold

input_needed: Access method and approval for any University system the team is permitted to view
why_needed: The kit is offline by construction and connects to nothing; any read access is a separate University decision

input_needed: Interview participant list with roles and availability windows
why_needed: Determines interview scheduling and which worksheets are used; no scheduling is performed by the kit

input_needed: Real SDLC and change-management documentation
why_needed: The analysis components read supplied documents; today they read a fictional corpus only

input_needed: Incident records for an agreed lookback window including postmortems and corrective-action status
why_needed: Incident learning needs at least one overdue action and one completed action to be assessable; the synthetic set supplies those only as fiction

input_needed: Backup job records AND at least one documented restoration exercise
why_needed: The kit deliberately separates backup completion from demonstrated restoration; only the University can supply evidence of the second

input_needed: Monitoring and alerting configuration exports or screenshots and any service objectives in force
why_needed: Observability assessment reads supplied evidence and connects to no monitoring system

input_needed: Security-event review records with ownership and disposition
why_needed: Security-event assessment evaluates supplied records only; it reads no SIEM or identity system

input_needed: Deployment records for a sample of releases with artifact identifiers and approval evidence
why_needed: Release provenance traces a deployment to an artifact digest; without real records the trace is fictional

input_needed: Current test-data catalog including ownership refresh cadence and retention rules
why_needed: Test-data readiness assesses a supplied catalog; it cannot enumerate datasets itself

input_needed: Inventory of AI tools currently in use separated into active use informal experimentation and planned
why_needed: The AI-use inventory is a collection instrument; the University holds the only accurate answer and informal use is easy to under-report

input_needed: Any existing AI or acceptable-use policy text in force
why_needed: Policy-to-workflow assessment compares written policy against observed workflow; it needs the actual policy text

input_needed: Delivery volume and timing data for an agreed measurement window
why_needed: Delivery metrics require stated workload sizes and a defined environment; estimates must be labelled as estimates not measured

input_needed: Staffing counts and role mix available for improvement work
why_needed: Resource and adoption estimates separate one-time from recurring effort and cannot be produced without a real capacity figure

input_needed: The University's own weighting of what matters most among quality security reliability and speed
why_needed: The prioritization weights are visible and adjustable on purpose; the defaults are placeholders not a recommendation

input_needed: Constraints that rule options out such as budget freezes procurement rules or union agreements
why_needed: A recommendation the University cannot act on is not a recommendation; the kit cannot infer these

input_needed: Named draft reviewers and the review window
why_needed: Documentation usability is measured from a real reviewer performing a real task; a synthetic reviewer proves only that the method runs

input_needed: University corrections and disagreements on the draft
why_needed: Unresolved disagreements are preserved rather than edited away; that requires the University to state them

input_needed: Required final-report format accessibility requirements and delivery channel
why_needed: The report structure and visual-language checks target a format the University has not yet specified

input_needed: Evidence disposition instruction for the RFQ's 30-day post-completion period
why_needed: The closeout kit validates a disposition record and deliberately deletes nothing; the instruction is the University's to give

input_needed: Whether the optional readout is wanted and who attends
why_needed: The deck architecture exists but its audience and depth are undetermined
